title: OUSD ticker collision, Open Standard/Origin Dollar separation, Bridge reserve API and SBI interoperability status

append_only.purpose: Resolve the OUSD ticker collision, distinguish Bridge-issued Open USD from Origin Dollar, reconcile live Bridge reserve data, and prevent the SBI/JPYSC pilot from being misread as production XRP demand.

source_capture_policy.reason: Rendered official web pages and JSON responses were reviewed; transport bytes and independent timestamp receipts were not preserved.

entity_resolution.rule: Ticker alone is not an entity identifier. Require issuer, chain and contract/mint address before attributing supply, price, reserve, transfer or collateral data.

project_linked_contract_directory.limitation: Project-linked transparency dashboard; issuer marketing page does not itself enumerate these addresses.

status_at_cutoff.onchain_status: Open Standard describes OUSD as live on four chains; the project-linked dashboard lists chain contracts.
status_at_cutoff.page_state_conflict: The same page labels the launch section 'Live now' while showing a future November 12 event, a countdown and a future first-live-payments description.
status_at_cutoff.interpretation: On-chain token availability and the later public launch/first-payments event are separate milestones.

origin_dollar.backing_and_strategy: Origin's official materials describe USDC backing and DeFi yield strategies including Morpho and Curve.
origin_dollar.history: Origin's official product page describes OUSD as growing in Ethereum wallets since 2020.

claims_supported: Bridge issues Open USD for Open Standard.
OUSD is described as live on Ethereum, Solana, Base and Tempo.
Page displays $468M circulation, 200+ partners and 54.9% cash / 45.1% short-dated Treasuries as of October 2026.
SBI Holdings and Coinbase appear in the selected network list.
Page advertises first live payments on November 12, 2026 at 09:00 PT.
limitations: $468M has no exact as-of timestamp or methodology.
Launch section simultaneously says 'Live now' and describes a future event with countdown.
Reserve mix is not a current independent attestation.
Visible partner list is not the full 200+ roster.

claims_supported: Bridge distinguishes on-demand liquid assets from Treasuries.
Off-chain USD is instantly redeemable during U.S. banking hours.
On-chain stablecoin reserves can provide 24/7 liquidity, subject to regulatory requirements.
Treasuries can require up to one business day for redemption.
limitations: General reserve-management documentation, not an OUSD-specific customer redemption SLA.

claims_supported: SBI Holdings and Startale joined Open Standard.
SBI/Startale said they would explore a JPYSC–OUSD interoperability proof of concept.
Release explicitly says this does not mean a new service or production settlement/trading has begun.
SBI Shinsei Trust Bank is JPYSC issuer.
limitations: Pilot exploration only; no production interoperability, volume or capital transfer.
140+ participant count differs from later 200+ page; date and counting methodology may differ.

claims_supported: Lists separate Open USD contracts on Tempo, Ethereum and Base and a Solana mint.
Says Bridge reports all-chain reserves and chain supply is read independently.
States dashboard is informational, not an independent reserve attestation.
limitations: Project-linked dashboard, not an independent issuer attestation.
Live figures did not render at this retrieval; contract links were visible.

claims_supported: Origin registry identifies Origin Dollar Ethereum ERC-20 as 0x2A8e1E676Ec238d8A992307B495b45B3fEAa5e86.
Origin product documentation describes yield-bearing USDC-backed DeFi strategies.
limitations: Origin Dollar is unrelated to Open Standard Open USD despite shared ticker.

cross_snapshot_change.interpretation: Different timestamped snapshots from the same Bridge source group. These changes do not independently prove net external capital inflow or completed customer payments.

marketing_page_disagreement.interpretation: Material discrepancy versus the timestamped Bridge API supply of approximately $909.56M. Definition, stale cache or page inconsistency is unresolved; preserve both and do not average.

attestation_status.interpretation: The visible August attestation predates launch and cannot independently attest November reserve snapshots.

reserve_reconciliation.liquidity_interpretation: The Treasury allocation is not equivalent to cash immediately redeemable 24/7. Bridge documentation distinguishes on-demand assets from Treasuries that can require one business day; exact OUSD customer redemption rights remain partner/contract-specific.

relationship_graph.relationship: interoperability proof of concept under consideration
relationship_graph.evidence: SBI/Startale October 16 release; explicitly not production
Origin official registry and product documentation

xrp_relationship_assessment.interpretation: Open Standard may compete with or complement USDC/RLUSD corporate settlement, but reviewed sources do not establish XRP, XRPL, Ripple or Circle in the OUSD issuance/settlement path. The SBI/Startale JPYSC–OUSD pilot is only under consideration.

counter_hypotheses.statement: OUSD may compete with USDC and RLUSD for corporate settlement and reserve-income economics.
support: Coinbase and SBI are listed network partners
Open Standard describes reserve-income sharing with network partners
disconfirming_or_missing: No disclosed SBI or Coinbase OUSD balances

counter_hypotheses.statement: JPYSC–OUSD interoperability could complement existing rails if the proposed proof of concept becomes production.
disconfirming_or_missing: No production service or settlement launch

counter_hypotheses.statement: A USD stablecoin paired with a JPY stablecoin could substitute for XRP in some future USD/JPY routes.
support: Both stablecoins target on-chain movement and the pilot targets JPY/USD interoperability
disconfirming_or_missing: No proof of production corridor or transaction path
No transaction-level comparison with XRP routes

counter_hypotheses.statement: OUSD growth may have no direct XRP demand effect.
support: XRPL absent from four listed networks
No XRP use or purchase disclosed
Reserve and circulation measure stablecoin infrastructure, not XRP flows
disconfirming_or_missing: Future integrations or measured XRP bridge transactions could change this assessment

reason: Rendered sources were not preserved as byte-complete raw receipts.
Bridge live telemetry is not a current independent reserve attestation.
Marketing circulation figure is materially inconsistent and undated.
Ticker-only OUSD observations can conflate two unrelated tokens.
No XRP/XRPL transaction or capital-flow evidence is disclosed.
